mapper.sql: SELECT flt13_book_init_id AS book_init_id , flt13_book_date AS book_date , flt13_account_id AS account_id , TO_DECRYPTS(flt03_account_no) || ' ' || sys15_corp_nm || ' ' || flt03_account_nm AS account_info , flt13_item_type AS item_type , flt05_item_type_nm AS item_type_name , COALESCE(flt05_stk_price_yn::varchar, 'false') = 'true' AS stk_price_yn , flt13_item_nm AS item_name , flt13_item_cd AS item_code , flt13_book_qty AS book_qty , flt13_book_amt AS book_amt FROM flt13_book_init INNER JOIN flt03_account ON flt03_account_id = flt13_account_id INNER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = flt03_corp_id INNER JOIN flt05_item_type ON ( flt05_company_id = flt13_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt13_item_type AND flt05_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(flt05_start_date) FROM flt05_item_type WHERE flt05_company_id = flt13_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt13_item_type AND flt05_start_date <= flt13_book_date ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flt13_book_init (flt13_book_init_id, flt13_company_id, flt13_person_id, flt13_account_id, flt13_item_nm, flt13_item_type, flt13_book_date, flt13_book_amt, flt13_book_qty, flt13_item_cd) VALUES (#{id}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{req.accountId}, #{req.itemName}, #{req.itemType}, #{req.bookDate}, #{req.bookAmt}, #{req.bookQty}, #{req.itemCode})

INSERT INTO flt13_book_init (flt13_book_init_id, flt13_company_id, flt13_person_id, flt13_account_id, flt13_item_nm, flt13_item_type, flt13_book_date, flt13_book_amt, flt13_book_qty, flt13_note, flt13_item_cd) VALUES (f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{accountId}, #{itemName}, #{itemType}, #{bookDate}, #{bookAmt}, #{bookQty}, NULL, #{itemCode})
mapper.select: SELECT sys12_working_yn FROM sys12_calendar INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = sys12_company_id WHERE sys12_company_id != 0 AND sys12_day = CAST(#{stdDate} AS timestamp) AND sys01_use_yn = 'true' ORDER BY sys01_company_id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flt14_relate_appr INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = flt14_appr_id WHERE flt14_person_id = #{personId} AND COALESCE(apr01_status_cd, '99') NOT IN ('99', '40')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flt11_book SELECT f_create_seq() , flt13_company_id , flt13_person_id , flt13_account_id , flt13_item_nm , flt13_item_type , flt13_book_date , flt13_book_amt , flt13_book_qty , flt13_note , flt13_book_date , TRUNC(flt13_book_amt / flt13_book_qty) , flt13_book_amt , flt13_item_cd FROM flt13_book_init INNER JOIN flt05_item_type ON ( flt05_company_id = flt13_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt13_item_type AND flt05_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(flt05_start_date) FROM flt05_item_type WHERE flt05_company_id = flt13_company_id AND flt05_item_type_cd = flt13_item_type AND flt05_start_date <= flt13_book_date ) ) WHERE flt13_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt13_person_id = #{personId} AND flt13_account_id = #{accountId} AND flt13_item_type = #{itemType} AND ( ( COALESCE(flt05_stk_price_yn::varchar, 'false') = 'true' AND flt13_item_cd = #{itemCode} ) OR ( COALESCE(flt05_stk_price_yn::varchar, 'false') != 'true' AND flt13_item_nm = #{itemName} ) )
